# the base ring at y1; rx/rz are the half-widths of the rings on local X / Z, cx/cz the axis's offset.
# r g b is the cone texture's own alpha-weighted colour (the cone's OWN colour, not the sun's).
# census (MM010, 18 frames): 20/20 x42, 32/44 x15
